description: The initial segments indexed from omega up to omega one form a family of cardinality aleph one of countably infinite sets, every delta-system subfamily of which has at most two members.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.countable_infinite_initial_segments_specification :
  ¬Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.countableInfiniteInitialSegments.Countable ∧
    Cardinal.mk ↑Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.countableInfiniteInitialSegments =
        Cardinal.lift.{1, 0} (Cardinal.aleph 1) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.countableInfiniteInitialSegments, a.Countable ∧ a.Infinite) ∧
        ∀ B ⊆ Lemmatheca.Entry.PressingDownAndDeltaSystems.countableInfiniteInitialSegments,
          ∀ (r : Set Ordinal.{0}), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.DeltaSystems.IsDeltaSystem B r → B.Finite ∧ B.ncard ≤ 2
